C0155.title: Baihao's 'Red Packet Hunter' Auto-Grab Software Ordered to Pay 700,000 Yuan Compensation
C0155.summary: The Hangzhou Internet Court ruled in its final judgment that Hangzhou Baihao Company and others developed and operated software such as 'Red Packet Hunter', which enabled automatic red packet grabbing by monitoring QQ notification bar messages and simulating clicks, constituting unfair competition.
